name: @amykit/plugin-serial-engine
description: Advances one work item by one move per tick.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Every install that runs work needs an engine, and this is the default: each tick it advances one work item by one move. It needs a workflow, a queue and a record store, so pair it with file-queue and file-store, and it asks the budget before anything expensive. Choose concurrent-engine instead when the lanes of a fork should move together.
